t.zh: 板不知道现在是第几拍。可很多数列的第 n 项只和 n 有关，先得让板知道 n。
t.en: The board does not know which tick it is. Yet the n-th term of many sequences depends only on n, so first the board must know n.

t.zh: 第几项本身就是一个数列：0, 1, 2, 3, …。搭好它，下标 n 就成了一件元件，以后随取随用。
t.en: Which term it is forms a sequence of its own: 0, 1, 2, 3, …. Built, the index n becomes a part, there for later levels to take.

after.zh: 下标 n 也是递推出来的：首项 0，每项加 1。
after.en: The index n is a recurrence too: start at 0, add 1 each time.

desc.en: Gives which term this tick is: 0, 1, 2, …

brief.zh: 每一拍交出这是第几项：0, 1, 2, 3, …
brief.en: Each tick give which term it is: 0, 1, 2, 3, …
